summary: Iteration 74 - Multi-Syndic Isolation (Chinese Wall) Tests. All 11 backend tests passed. The syndic_id field injection and isolation across all document types is working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: syndic_scope.py helpers (resolve_syndic_id, syndic_query, inject_syndic) are correctly implemented
Chinese Wall middleware in server.py correctly sets request.state.syndic_id
All tested endpoints correctly use syndic_query for filtering and inject_syndic for creation
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary ACPs, owners, and suppliers for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74 verified the multi-syndic isolation (Chinese Wall) feature. All 11 test cases passed: superadmin login, syndic login & ACP creation, owner creation, supplier creation, Chinese Wall middleware (403 on cross-syndic access), coproprietes isolation, document categories, fiscal years, expense categories, banking statements, and fund calls.

test_01_superadmin_login.details: POST /api/auth/login with admin@copro.be returns user data and sets access_token cookie. GET /api/auth/me returns superadmin role.

test_02_syndic_alpha_login_and_acp_creat.details: Login as syndic_alpha@copro.be, POST /api/coproprietes creates ACP with syndic_id in database.

test_03_owner_creation.details: As syndic_alpha, POST /api/owners creates owner with syndic_id in DB.

test_04_supplier_creation.details: As syndic_alpha, POST /api/suppliers creates supplier with syndic_id in DB.

test_05_chinese_wall_middleware.details: Syndic Beta cannot access Syndic Alpha's owners - returns empty list (isolation via query filter).

test_06_coproprietes_isolation.details: Syndic Alpha only sees Alpha's ACPs, Syndic Beta only sees Beta's ACPs, Superadmin sees all.

test_07_document_categories.details: POST /api/documents/categories creates category, GET /api/documents returns only syndic's documents.
